page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of most lines, so the final words of many lines are missing; only the visible text is transcribed. The page number is printed as an old-style 5 that resembles a section sign, read here as 572. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: the word after "Agri" and the broken word "infole-tiam" are unclear, and the "s[?]" in "pisces marini s[?]-fugini" is a guess. The printed "ded-xerunt" and "affi-viffent" hyphens may be faint or lost in the crop. Normalised: "eft" to "est", "falfedo" kept as printed, and the running head and article heading have u/v changed to u.
